mode: nonfunctional synthetic key values and provider request stubs; actual static build boundary
modernAuth: publishable apikey; bearer only for the separate user session
modernStorage: secret apikey only; no API-key bearer
legacyFallback: JWT transport only when corresponding modern setting is absent
invalidModernSetting: fails closed without silently falling back
userVerification: authoritative provider user endpoint and approved account unchanged
secretBoundary: no configured key in public status/error, static module/asset or RPC body
